name: Roswell
source:
Roswell is the lead mechanic on the Hesperides space station. They're incredibly skilled at their job, and were considered a prodigy of robotics when they were younger.

They have a bubbly and friendly personality, and are the player's neighbour.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/330388878/love-at-the-milky-way-diner/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
